import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Handle 'Sleep Disorder' NaN values by replacing them with 'No Disorder'
df['Sleep Disorder'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('No Disorder')

# Define an explicit order for categorical variables for better visualization
# BMI Category order from healthy to less healthy
bmi_order = ['Normal-Weight', 'Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
df['BMI Category'] = pd.Categorical(df['BMI Category'], categories=bmi_order, ordered=True)

# Sleep Disorder order, placing 'No Disorder' first
sleep_disorder_order = ['No Disorder', 'Insomnia', 'Sleep Apnea']
df['Sleep Disorder'] = pd.Categorical(df['Sleep Disorder'], categories=sleep_disorder_order, ordered=True)

# Set up the matplotlib figure and axes for two subplots
# Using sharey=False because Sleep Duration and Quality of Sleep have different scales
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(18, 7), sharey=False)

# Plot 1: Sleep Duration distribution by BMI Category, colored by Sleep Disorder
sns.violinplot(
    x='BMI Category',
    y='Sleep Duration',
    hue='Sleep Disorder',
    data=df,
    ax=axes[0],
    palette='viridis',
    inner='quartile', # Show quartiles inside the violins
    dodge=True        # Separate violins for different hues
)
axes[0].set_title('Sleep Duration Distribution by BMI Category and Sleep Disorder', fontsize=14)
axes[0].set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=12)
axes[0].set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=30) # Rotate x-axis labels for better readability
axes[0].legend(title='Sleep Disorder', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left', frameon=False)
axes[0].grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7) # Add grid for easier value reading

# Plot 2: Quality of Sleep distribution by BMI Category, colored by Sleep Disorder
sns.violinplot(
    x='BMI Category',
    y='Quality of Sleep',
    hue='Sleep Disorder',
    data=df,
    ax=axes[1],
    palette='viridis',
    inner='quartile', # Show quartiles inside the violins
    dodge=True        # Separate violins for different hues
)
axes[1].set_title('Quality of Sleep Distribution by BMI Category and Sleep Disorder', fontsize=14)
axes[1].set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=12)
axes[1].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10 scale)', fontsize=12)
axes[1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=30) # Rotate x-axis labels for better readability
axes[1].legend(title='Sleep Disorder', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left', frameon=False)
axes[1].grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7) # Add grid for easier value reading

# Add a main title for the entire figure
plt.suptitle('Impact of BMI Category and Sleep Disorders on Sleep Metrics', fontsize=18, y=1.03)

# Adjust layout to prevent labels/titles from overlapping and make room for legends
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 0.95, 0.98])

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
